profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Experienced Operator with a demonstrated history of working in the Military industry. Skilled in Software Engineering, Python (Programming Language), Java (Programming Language), Analytical Skills, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel(Data Management) and Computer Science. Strong operations professional currently in pursuit of Bachelor's degree focused in Computer Science from University of Maryland Global Campus.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.locationName: Fort Liberty, North Carolina, USA · On-site
positions.description:
• Lead CI/CD operations within a collaborative 9-member development team, supporting the Joint Intelligence Brigade for the Joint Special Operations Command, ensuring efficient deployment of web and micro-applications.
• Develop and maintain Python-based applications, leveraging Docker and Kubernetes to enhance functionality and scalability, including a language translation tool capable of processing .doc, audio, and .txt files into multiple languages.
• Engineered a social media scraping program for platforms like Twitter and Instagram, enabling the collection of critical forensic data on persons of interest to aid decision-making processes.
• Built a Linux-based desktop application, optimizing file sorting and grouping based on specific criteria, and ensuring seamless integration of outputs into Windows OS environments as .exe files.
• Utilize Git for version control, promoting code integrity and collaboration within the team, while consistently delivering high-quality, user-focused solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Python (Programming Language) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Active TS/SCI Clearance · GitHub · Linux · Programming · Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed as a Core Storage Engineer on the Storage Firmware Team, developing and enhancing solutions using Python, Flask, and HTML/CSS to support scalable firmware management.
• Designed and implemented a Python-based web tool for log analysis, improving debugging efficiency and streamlining workflow navigation for engineering teams.
• Collaborated in an Agile environment, using Jira for project tracking, Bitbucket for version control, and Confluence for documentation to ensure alignment and transparency within a six-member team.
• Participated in daily stand-ups and sprint retrospectives, fostering effective communication, troubleshooting issues, and delivering high-quality solutions on schedule.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Front-End Development · Jira · Python (Programming Language) · Bitbucket · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Agile Methodologies · HTML · Confluence · GitHub · Git

positions.title: MQ-9 LRE Sensor Operator
positions.description: Deploys worldwide to support MQ-9 Reaper launch & recovery operations. Executes departure/arrival procedures that support missions directed by Major Command Officials in the Air Force. Utilizes effective team communication to navigate through aircraft checklists/technical orders to assist lead pilot with safe maneuvering & landing recovery during critical aircraft emergencies. Collects geospatial data, using technologies such as aerial photography, light and radio wave detection systems, digital satellites, or thermal energy systems. Evaluates remote sensing project requirements to determine the types of equipment or computer software necessary to meet project requirements, such as specific image types or output resolutions.

positions.title: Squadron Training Manager
positions.description: Oversaw the assigning and issuing of training of a squadron that included 50+ personnel. Developed Microsoft Excel documents that tracked the currencies of the assigned personnel. Briefed higher management with the use of Microsoft PowerPoint. Scheduled required training on behalf of individuals within the squadron.

positions.title: Assistant Dedicated Crew Chief
positions.description: Assistant Dedicated Crew Chief on the B-2 Bomber aircraft. Maintained the overall functional capabilities of 20 individual aircraft daily. Led groups of 3-4 personnel to complete required maintenance of aircraft. Performed routine inspections of aircraft to ensure proper functional capabilities. Briefed aircrew of the status and condition of aircraft prior to launch. Maintained an accurate record of maintenance performed, required and servicing of associated oil, fuel and hydraulic systems for each aircraft.

positions.title: Flight Leader
positions.description: Assigned Flight Leader while attending Airman Leadership School. Responsible for the readiness and well-being of 30 individuals. Ensured 100% graduation rate.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Utilizes agile methodologies to manage 10 projects progress to 5 stakeholders and product owners.
•	Develops full-stack web application using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS; built new features from product mock-ups and user stories.
•	Codes software changes using Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery principles to increase collaboration, product delivery, and deployment frequency.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · Leadership · Analytical Skills · Java · Front-End Development · Teamwork · Python (Programming Language) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Node.js · Agile Methodologies · JavaScript · HTML · GitHub · Git
